scope: Read-only audit of one authorized firefly-nightwatch continuation after deployment of the 202 fixes; paused at user request. No further paid request, game patch, frontend or Claude Code source edit.

mainPhases.name: Write, repair and inspect DPR tests

usage.method: Half-open transcript event ranges, main-thread message_delta usage only. Child and interrupted usage counted separately; phases are temporal buckets, not a claim that every token in a bucket is avoidable. Cached inputs are not priced like uncached inputs. Previous 14,509,301-token turn excluded.

findings.category: BGS context policy plus ordinary native history replay
findings.evidence: agentMessageSchema disallows focused for continue; execute passes previous nativeSessionId unless explicitly focused. This paid request used continue. Main request input grew from 125,592 to 152,578 tokens; 33 completed main requests consumed 4,662,560 tokens.
findings.root: Interruption recovery and full conversation replay are coupled. This is not evidence of a compaction hang: no compaction event was observed in this turn. Fixing tool help did not affect this multiplier.
findings.boundary: Preserving interrupted intent/results is necessary; silently resetting history or dropping unresolved outcomes is not an acceptable fix.

findings.category: Native verification policy, not merely BGS business review
findings.status: confirmed code path and actual verification invocation
findings.evidence: Current dist/cli-bun.js -> dist/cli.js -> build-pQANhD retains the non-trivial-work independent-verification contract, including rerunning 2-3 commands after PASS. The build enables VERIFICATION_AGENT and local tengu_hive_evidence=true. User poorMode was unset. Log event 14366 actually invokes subagent_type=verification. Its built-in prompt requires build/test execution and adversarial checks. A Todo completion nudge also exists, but its activation in this turn was not established.
findings.root: Removing a BGS Review stage did not remove native-layer verification instructions. The optional-agent comment does not match the mandatory prompt contract. Child instructions also prohibit project writes while requiring a build, although this project's build rewrites dist.
findings.boundary: No Claude Code source was changed. Any proposed correction must respect the user's no-core-change boundary; no poor-mode or security override was enabled.

findings.evidence: Main events 13624 and 13639 fail against old endpoints, then 13675/13689 obtain current preview access. Child handoff includes direct CDP/server URLs and rerun commands; its test command uses bun instead of node, then parses a failed process output as JSON. Existing withPreviewPage resolves current capability and enforces Node, but these scripts do not use it.
findings.root: New optional tool support does not migrate retained scripts, old endpoints or the caller's handoff. Recovery therefore repeatedly re-discovers environment and execution details.
findings.boundary: Recreating expired capabilities is correct security behavior. Do not preserve expired permissions just to reduce calls.

findings.category: Agent operation granularity and result handling
findings.evidence: DPR script had three separate edits (13901,13910,13919). Event 13928 ran a successful test but a final grep for failures returned exit 1; 13988 issued another command only to count checks. Main Todo calls each carried roughly 134k-148k input/output tokens. Child reran checks after tail output did not show validity, then ran again to grep valid.
findings.root: The cost is whole-context model requests around small operations, not the CPU cost of the script, shell or Todo itself. Request planning and reusable result summaries remain fragmented.

findings.category: BGS measurement granularity plus Agent ordering
findings.evidence: Measurement event 14195 precedes TECHNICAL_DESIGN.md edit 14558. projectFiles hashes all exportable docs/tests, and measured-build freshness compares the entire list. Agent explicitly states it must measure again after the doc update. The current build script copies index.html/src/content only; the edited docs are not part of this game's runtime output.
findings.root: An editable-source package identity and runtime-test freshness are currently coupled. This correctly prevents mislabeling changed exports but over-invalidates runtime evidence for this non-runtime documentation change.
findings.boundary: Do not simply exclude docs for every project: another build may genuinely consume them. No second measurement occurred before pause, so do not count a predicted rerun as spent tokens.

findings.evidence: verify.mjs teleports the player and refills oil for three-level progression; exit code only checks hardErrors, not false checks. This round has one legitimate keyboard-only L1 completion, not L2/L3. Host measure selects only menu start/title at 1280x720; procedural Scene/lighting/WebAudio remain outside its probes. The child handoff states zero external resources as an original requirement even though the original policy was optional library use.
findings.root: Rerunning the same test coverage is not independent evidence of omitted gameplay or quality. Requirements, chosen implementation and test shortcuts are blurred in handoff. More requests have not established broader acceptance.
findings.boundary: Forced state tests are useful for state/UI transitions, but cannot prove normal route feasibility or balance. No game-source repair was made by this auditor.

remainingUnproven: bun run build failed with CouldntReadCurrentDirectory even after explicit cd; direct bun scripts/build.mjs then succeeded. This is narrower than 'wrong working directory'. The Bun child-process/sandbox root cause needs a separate isolated reproduction; permissions were not relaxed.

Full model API system-message capture was not enabled. Native verification attribution is grounded in the running compiled build, default/config paths and actual verification invocation, not a raw API-prompt dump.
No legacy handoff command was invoked in this continuation; default-help adoption by a new author, Camera envelope input and consumer --api were not exercised.
No new Skill calls in this continuation; nine professional Skills were loaded in the retained preceding context. Zero new calls is not proof that Skills were absent.
DPR samples and one saved screenshot support the specific lamp-alignment repair; full gameplay, art/audio quality and three legitimate level completions remain unaccepted.
nextAuditPriority: Resolve native mandatory-verification versus optional verification policy without adding another Review prompt or assuming BGS has removed it.
Separate durable task/outcome recovery from optional replay of unrelated old history, preserving current authority and unresolved outcomes.
Make retained tests consume the current test-entry/environment contract and complete machine-readable results, instead of hand-copied URLs and repeated grep.
Distinguish export freshness from affected runtime-test validity using actual dependency evidence; preserve historical identities.
Evaluate missing player-flow and quality evidence before repeating an existing green suite. Do not claim that deterministic probes solve subjective game quality.
